Print generated schema docs for Noodle runtime contracts

Usage:
  noodle schema [target] [flags]
  noodle schema [command]

Available Commands:
  list        List available schema targets

Flags:
  -h, --help   help for schema

Global Flags:
      --project-dir string   project directory (default: current directory, env: NOODLE_PROJECT_DIR)

Use "noodle schema [command] --help" for more information about a command.
